text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus finds an extraordinary degree 
of rivalry directed toward him by Hishi 
Amazon at the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon said she was glad Narita 
Brian made a comeback, but at the same 
time, she felt frustrated that she hadn't 
been the one to bring it out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus accomplished what they could 
not. That is precisely why they must 
defeat her. Biko Pegasus accepts the 
challenge.
